title: Ultimate Puff Pineapple Crush Soda Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: A mouth-watering soda-inspired juice from Ultimate Salts, Pineapple Crush is a refreshing burst of tangy, tropical Pineapple with a refreshingly cool, icy Menthol breeze riding above the sweet exhale. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the Nicotine Salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
